calls.statement:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_ids,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_day,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hel_day,
 MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-27 00:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (
 SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
 WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled'
), t AS (
 SELECT l.receipt_id, MAX(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test,
        MIN(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_test, COUNT(*) AS lines, MAX(s.store_id) AS sid
 FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=l.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=l.store_key
 WHERE l.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS d, SUM(CASE WHEN t.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
 SUM(COALESCE(t.has_test,0)) AS with_test, SUM(COALESCE(t.all_test,0)) AS all_test,
 SUM(CASE WHEN t.lines<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing,
 COUNT(DISTINCT t.sid) AS store_ids, MIN(t.sid), MAX(t.sid)
FROM o LEFT JOIN t ON t.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
